observations: The real Web product injected the same generic AGENTS.md and requested the exact qwen/qwen3.5-9b:nitro model. The model made one valid bash tool call to list the workspace.
On the next step it placed an XML-style read invocation inside its reasoning text, returned stop instead of toolUse, and ended the turn without reading the CSV or creating any application.
The failure occurred in 4.672 seconds of model time and is a model-harness tool-call compatibility failure, not evidence that the underlying data task was unusually difficult.

The remaining frozen turns were not sent. This one-case diagnostic is not the formal three-pair futility rule, but it agrees with the separate default-Cline 9B screen where three paired cases produced three non-openable applications and triggered the frozen futility rule.
evidence_notes: Reject 9B for the current Cline and DeepSeek Web harnesses. A future grammar-constrained tool adapter could be tested as a different harness track, but the model is not workshop-ready as configured.
